name: Hiroshima Nagasaki
caption: Won the promotion's own January battle royal for the top contendership to the Television Championship, then chased the belt through February as one half of the Rising Sons tag team.

tenures.source: the promotion's own January-February 2001 television tapings

name: Justin Hart
caption: The Street Soldier, a battle royal entrant who feuded with Jason Flint and the Rising Sons through the promotion's January and February 2001 cards.

tenures.source: the promotion's own January-February 2001 television tapings

identity.note: Shares only a name with CWF-Pro's own Mr. Tuesday Night Justin Hart (1997), an unrelated roster years earlier.

name: Kidd Gannon
caption: A battle royal entrant who pinned manager Lonny Nakamura in an impromptu singles match after his scheduled opponent failed to appear.

tenures.source: the promotion's own January 2001 television tapings

name: Suicide Youth
caption: A masked battle royal entrant eliminated by Justin Hart.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 7 January 2001 television taping

name: the Offspring
caption: A masked veteran who returned to the promotion's ring in a battle royal and a tag match against the Rising Sons before departing for Continental Superstars Wrestling in February 2001.

tenures.source: the promotion's own January 2001 television tapings

identity.note: Shares only a name with WOPW's own the Offspring (1999), an unrelated roster in a different promotion.

name: Brutal Brian Floyd
caption: An Oklahoma-based ally of Drake Russell who wrestled Jake Morgan on the promotion's own cards.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 7 January 2001 television taping

name: Lonny Nakamura
caption: Manager of the Rising Sons who wrestled Kidd Gannon in an impromptu singles match.

tenures.source: the promotion's own January-February 2001 television tapings

name: Jeremy Morgan
caption: Jake Morgan's brother, who ran in to help the Offspring against the Rising Sons and was pinned in the ensuing tag match.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 14 January 2001 television taping

name: Pep Preston
caption: A member of Hiroshima Nagasaki's faction who lost to Jason Flint in a falls-count-anywhere brawl.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 21 January 2001 television taping

name: Paco
caption: A sequined valet turned in-ring competitor who lost to Jason Flint.

tenures.source: the promotion's own January 2001 television tapings

identity.note: Shares only a name with CWF's own Paco (1998-2003), an unrelated later roster.

name: GD West
caption: A visiting wrestler billed from the National Wrestling Council who feuded with the Rising Sons and Justin Hart on the promotion's own cards.

tenures.source: the promotion's own January-February 2001 television tapings
